text:
maria: Heads up — noticed a 12% drop in MQL->SQL conversion for the cohort that attended last week's webinar. Can we do a quick microcheck on dashboard vs routing before next week's follow-up?

tyler: ugh. saw the raw leads spike but conversion down? could be routing delays or bad qualification rules.

sanjay: pulling cohort now. quick snapshot: webinar cohort (utm=webinar_apr14) sessions=1,842 leads=128 MQLs=64 SQLs=18. prior webinar cohort had SQLs=25 with similar leads.

maria: thx. do we have per-source breakdown? e.g., organic vs paid vs partner?

sanjay: yep - quick split: paid=54 leads (MQL 22), organic=38 (MQL 18), partner=36 (MQL 24). partner MQL->SQL conversion looks worse than usual.

amanda: routing note — partner leads go to a separate inbox and then routed via webhook to sales. I saw a webhook error around 10:12am the day after the webinar. logs: `POST /hooks/leads 500` x 27.

maria: can you paste the log snippet?

amanda: sure.

amanda: ```
2026-03-10T10:12:04Z POST /hooks/leads 500 {"error":"timeout","attempt":1}
2026-03-10T10:12:05Z POST /hooks/leads 500 {"error":"timeout","attempt":2}
... 27 failures over 9m ...
```

tyler: that would explain partner backlog. some leads may have expired or been reclassified by the qualification job.

olivia: qualification job runs every 6h. if webhook failed, partner leads might have reingested during the next batch and lost original webinar tag. we saw similar tag-loss last quarter.

maria: oh that could break attribution and make conversions look worse. how many partner leads hit reingest?

sanjay: checking enrich pipeline: approx 29 partner leads were reprocessed and re-tagged without utm params.

maria: that's the 12% drop right there? can we do a corrective mapping to restore utm tag for those 29 so reporting shows true funnel?

sanjay: yes we can infer from timestamp + email cohort and set utm=webinar_apr14 for reporting layer. want me to run a backfill view?

amanda: also recommend fixing webhook retry logic; current backoff is linear. switch to exponential and cap attempts to avoid reprocessing duplicates.

tyler: agree. ops task for eng-sre.

olivia: for the current weekly KPI board, I'll add an annotation for March 10 to flag the webhook incident so weekly review shows the anomaly.

maria: great. two asks: 1) sanjay, run the backfill/reporting fix so dashboard shows corrected conversion and 2) amanda/eng set webhook retry fix. can we have quick updates by EOD?

sanjay: will run backfill now, estimate 45m. i'll post a before/after snapshot.

amanda: i'll open a jira for webhook retry + idempotency header. tagging @eng-sre.

kpi-bot: KPI alert: MQL->SQL conversion dropped 12% for utm=webinar_apr14 on 2026-03-10. Link: https://dash.redwood.ai/boards/marketing/kpis?focus=webinar_apr14

maria: thanks all. if the backfill restores conversion to prior level we can proceed with the planned nurture sequence. if not, we'll treat this as a messaging/regression call next week.

tyler: also quick note — messaging in follow-up emails was tweaked for A/B test B, maybe check version distribution across partner vs paid to rule out content effect.

sanjay: will include email-version dimension in the backfill.

maria: okay closing loop after EOD snapshots. :thumbsup:
